"index"
The index of the GPU.
"uuid"
The globally unique immutable UUID.
"name"
The official product name of the GPU.
"utilization.gpu"
Percent of time over the past sample period.
"temperature.gpu"
Core GPU temperature.
"power.draw"
The last measured power draw.
"memory.total"
Total installed GPU memory.
"memory.used"
Used GPU memory.
